name: exec_command
description: Execute a shell command in the assigned isolated workspace. Omit cwd to use the assigned workspace; a task/source file's location is not necessarily your writable workspace. Each call starts independently: cd and environment changes do not carry into later calls. Long commands return a sessionId for poll_command or stop_command; poll only that returned ID. timeout is the total execution deadline in seconds (default 120); yield_time_ms controls only the initial wait (default 10000). No interactive stdin or PTY. Use require_escalated only when this exact command needs access outside the sandbox; Bello must approve it before execution. Approval does not change later calls, file-tool scope, or cwd path checks.

cwd.description: Existing directory in the assigned filesystem scope. Relative values resolve from the assigned workspace, not a previous command's cwd. Omit for the workspace root. No ~ or environment-variable expansion. Escalation does not permit an otherwise out-of-scope cwd.

max_output_tokens.description: Approximate returned-text budget; default and host ceiling 10000 tokens. Keeps beginning and end when truncated.

name: poll_command
description: Read new output and status from this turn's managed command session without starting another command. Use only the exact sessionId returned by exec_command in this turn; never invent an ID or use a PID, callId, or session ID from another tool. A denied or completed command without a sessionId cannot be polled.

session_id.description: Copy the sessionId returned by exec_command in this turn verbatim.

max_output_tokens.description: Approximate returned-text budget; default and host ceiling 10000 tokens.

name: stop_command
description: Stop this turn's managed command session and wait for its sandbox cleanup. Use only the exact sessionId returned by exec_command in this turn; never invent an ID or use a PID or callId.

session_id.description: Copy the sessionId returned by exec_command in this turn verbatim.

name: view_image
description: Read a PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP image from the assigned workspace for visual inspection.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the assigned workspace, not the last exec_command cwd. No ~ or environment-variable expansion.

name: read_file
description: Read an existing UTF-8 file; line numbers are one-based. Use offset and limit for longer files. File paths resolve from the assigned workspace, not the task/source file location or last command's cwd. File tools have no cwd argument, and command escalation does not expand their scope. A denied or failed command may not have created its intended output; verify completion before reading it.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the assigned workspace, not the last exec_command cwd. No ~ or environment-variable expansion.

name: write_file
description: Create or replace a UTF-8 file in the assigned workspace. Prefer workspace-relative paths for generated files. A readable task/source file's location is not necessarily writable. File tools have no cwd argument, and command escalation does not expand their scope.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the assigned workspace, not the last exec_command cwd. No ~ or environment-variable expansion.

name: edit_file
description: Replace an exact text occurrence in a file in the assigned workspace. Fails if the old text is absent or ambiguous. File tools have no cwd argument, and command escalation does not expand their scope.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the assigned workspace, not the last exec_command cwd. No ~ or environment-variable expansion.
Absolute path or path relative to the assigned workspace, not the last exec_command cwd. No ~ or environment-variable expansion. Use . for the workspace root.

name: search
description: Search text files under a path for a regular expression.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the assigned workspace, not the last exec_command cwd. No ~ or environment-variable expansion. Use . for the workspace root.

name: spawn_agent
description: Delegate an independent subtask to a Bello-managed child using an allowed model and effort.

name: send_message
description: Send instructions to an existing child agent.

name: wait_agent
description: Wait for a child to finish and return its result. timeout is in seconds, not milliseconds (default 60, maximum 3600). A wait timeout does not stop the child; wait again for the same child if it is still working.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait, not milliseconds. Default 60; use 120 for two minutes. Range 0 to 3600.

name: close_agent
description: Stop and close a child agent.
